diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the swallowing assessment (PF1), passed in 3 out of 4 rollouts despite the lone decision-maker having no access to PF1. The model consistently assigned the pump to 'Patient A' and selected 'Enteral feeding', likely due to a narrative stereotype or bias toward a specific patient when faced with an unresolved choice between Patient A and B.

C1.why: The swallowing assessment changes the allocation from an unresolved choice between Patients A and B to Patient A and changes the feeding method to continuous pump administration.

commitments.detail: Assignment of the single available enteral feeding pump for discharge use.
